'''Level 20''' was a level of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] on which the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] the [[Headache Bar]] operated<ref name="TF" /> during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|28|Headache Bar}}</ref> and into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mander Zuma]] and his associates [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] ventured to Level 20 while investigating the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|tempest]] and met with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]] at the Headache Bar.<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>
